executive_summary.conclusion: Mosaic Learning is crawlable and its enrollment guide and application page expose clear audience, eligibility, deadline and next-step facts. Two task-labeled navigation routes do not answer the task implied by their labels, leaving price and learning-material details unresolved in the inspected sample.

not_checked: Rendered browser behavior, mobile layout, keyboard/focus behavior, overlays and context retention were not checked because no browser lane was available.
Off-site retrieval and independent corroboration were not checked; this local site has no usable public search baseline.
Actual assistant visibility/citation rates, provider IP access, Search Console settings and behavioral analytics were not measured.

findings.title: Bookshop prices route does not provide prices

evidence.observation: The home navigation labels /c03-b/pricing.html as ‘Bookshop prices’, but the destination only says ‘General school information’ and directs readers to the enrollment guide; no price or fee is stated in the captured page text.

suggested_action.summary: Add current bookshop/course price information to the pricing destination or rename the link to match its actual purpose.
suggested_action.mechanism: Aligns the navigation label, destination content and quotable fee facts so a prospective learner can resolve the cost question in one route.
suggested_action.verification: Open the home ‘Bookshop prices’ link and confirm the destination contains the applicable price, currency and conditions, or that the link label accurately describes the generic information page.

findings.title: Learning materials route does not describe learning materials

evidence.observation: The home navigation labels /c03-b/products.html as ‘Learning materials’, but the destination repeats ‘General school information’ and links to the enrollment guide without identifying materials, availability or requirements.

suggested_action.summary: Publish the materials information on the products destination or retitle the navigation route to reflect its actual enrollment-guide handoff.
suggested_action.owner_hint: Content owner and course operations webmaster
suggested_action.mechanism: Gives prospective learners a direct, machine-readable answer about required or available materials and preserves a clear route to enrollment.
suggested_action.verification: Follow the home ‘Learning materials’ link and confirm the destination names the relevant materials and any conditions, or uses a label that accurately describes the generic page.

readiness.detail: robots.txt permits all named search, training and user-fetch cohorts, and all five inspected pages returned successful HTML responses; actual provider access remains unverified.
Static source captures expose readable headings, passages and links across the five inspected HTML pages.
Offer, audience, eligibility, dates, deadline and application steps are answerable; price and learning-material questions remain partial on their labeled destinations.
No independent public source was available in the bounded audit to corroborate the local brand, offering or dated enrollment claims.
Source journeys reached the enrollment guide and application instructions; the price and materials routes were observable but did not complete the task implied by their labels.
